newsitem.title: ISRAEL: ECI gets China approval of Ji Tong deal.
newsitem.headline: ECI gets China approval of Ji Tong deal.

text.p: ECI Telecom Ltd said the Chinese government approved an agreement with Ji Tong Communications Co and China National Technical Import and Export Corp to provide an information network for Ji Tong's Golden Bridge project.
The Israeli company will design with Ji Tong and will provide, install and commission wide area network and data communication solutions in three stages.

The first stage will cover 16 cities with initial applications being Internet service provisioning and access. The network will be upgraded in stage two and service provided to additional citites. Both stages, which amount to about $10 million, are expected to be deployed in 1997.
In 1998, stage three will be implemented to further upgrade and expand the network and support additional cities throughout China.
The financing of the agreement, which was signed in Beijing last December, will be provided under the protocol of financial cooperation between China and Israel.
